laws.rule: Visitors must not carve or scribble on sites or facilities, throw rubbish, shout, spit or urinate in the open, must respect local customs and religion, and must follow the safety directions of guides and tour leaders (article 25). Breaches are punished under the other laws that apply, and a visitor is liable for loss or injury caused (article 46).
laws.penalty_signal: Penalty set by the other laws named in article 46; not stated in this regulation.
